dct_description_sm: The main objectives of this study were: a) to reconstruct the nature of the paleoenvironments which succeeded themselves in the region since the last deglaciation (between 7.7 ka BP and 6 ka BP); b) to compare the results of this research with those of other paleoclimate studies in the vicinity of the Foxe Basin region (south-western Baffin Island, northern Qubec, eastern part of the Keewatin District, Labrador); and c) to fill the void of information on climatic and environmental changes that occurred in the study area during the postglacial period.
dct_title_s: Limnological data from Southampton Island lakes, Nunavut
